verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Vanta helps customers "collaborate seamlessly with auditors" and offers an Auditor API that audit firms use to run audits inside Vanta. That is collaboration tooling for auditors, not a way to book an audit. Nothing in the pack describes a vetted auditor network, an in-house audit arm, booking an audit through Vanta, or published timeline expectations. The axis fits a compliance-automation platform, so missing evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline
